scope.review_method: Sol agent review with no additional model subprocesses

established_source_parity_defect: the Greek scorer omits the upstream response.strip gate, allowing six vacuous predicates to pass empty text when called through score.py
unresolved_protocol_findings: words:vowel ignores Latin vowels and accepts digit-only text
words:consonants lets a slash hide a nonconforming span under a whitespace-token convention
words:start_verb accepts clitic-first and interjection-first strings by suffix; whether a clitic-first verb phrase qualifies must be specified
the surface ηχώ is both a noun and a first-person verb, so a blanket blacklist would create false negatives
words:prime_lengths counts internal hyphen punctuation as a character although the Greek prompt says letters
punctuation-only output remains accepted by some upstream predicates and requires a protocol decision

observed_score_effect.empty_gate: none in the ten stored runs because none of the responses was blank or punctuation-only
observed_score_effect.start_verb: one stored peer instruction beginning with Σας scored true; this is a false positive under first-token POS semantics but unresolved under a clitic-first verb-phrase interpretation

checker_probe.safe_patch_scope: restore the upstream response.strip gate only; the earlier any(isalnum) gate and NON_VERBS additions were withdrawn

clear_task_preservation_defects.finding: The requested wordplay depends on the contrast between πότε and ποτέ, while no_accents removes the contrast; the accepted answer repeats an indistinguishable form.
The required ending Καλή συνέχεια conflicts with a ban on καλός and its inflections/derivatives; the five-character stem checker misses καλή and admits the impossible specification.

quality_concerns_not_counted_as_determin.finding: The required EΟΠΥΥ mention is irrelevant to the travel-song task and is inserted as padding.

sample_audit.unreviewed: Current factual accuracy and live-link validity were not externally re-verified; the bounded review tested task preservation, constraint semantics, and assembly routing.

routing_evidence.mixa_2027_09179: A semantically better editor proposal was reverted because it broke letter_freq; the original unsupported additions remained and edit_reverted records constraints broken: letter_freq.

disposition.greek_if_final: preserve immutable completed artifact; create a versioned repaired successor before reuse
disposition.reason: deterministic passes do not establish substantive task fulfillment, and the Greek words aggregate mixes faithful, retuned, and approximate predicates
